name: Dr. Elena Vance
bio: Dr. Elena Vance covers advanced computing, climate science, and applied physics. With over twelve years in specialized investigative journalism and a doctorate from Oxford, she tracks sovereign tech infrastructure and international scientific treaties.
credentials: Ph.D. in Computational Sciences, University of Oxford
Member of the Association of British Science Writers
Former European Research Council Press Fellow

name: Marcus Reid
bio: Marcus Reid reports on monetary policy, cross-border trade agreements, and energy commodities. Previously an equity research analyst in London and Frankfurt, he brings quantitative precision to macroeconomic coverage.
credentials: M.Sc. in International Finance, London School of Economics
Member of the Society for Advancing Business Editing and Writing

name: Julia Vance
bio: Julia Vance directs foreign desk coverage across European, Middle Eastern, and Asian security summits. Her work focuses on multilateral institutions, treaty negotiations, and trade corridors.
credentials: M.A. in International Relations, Georgetown University
Former Foreign Press Correspondent in Geneva

name: Tariq Mansoor
bio: Tariq Mansoor reports from Dubai and Cairo on regional infrastructure, sovereign wealth investments, and maritime trade routes through the Red Sea and Arabian Gulf.
credentials: B.A. in Journalism, American University in Cairo
10 Years Energy & Trade Coverage in the Gulf
Arab Reporters for Investigative Journalism Fellow
